validity.researcher_notes: This is exactly the multi-segment wiki union pattern the escalation memo (notes/escalation-2026-08-11-kazakhstan-system-level-values-on-strings.md) warns about, and I traced it to source on the wiki page itself. gem.wiki's own citation [3] for '508 mm' and '0.5 bcm/year' supports Segment I (length 152 km, start year 2011, status operating) -- I independently confirmed the ORIGIN of the 0.5 bcm/y figure: Government Resolution No. 1151 (30.11.2007, adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P070001151_, verified live, 'О строительстве газопровода \'Карачаганак - Уральск\''), fetched and read directly, describes the ORIGINAL pipeline (~147 km, three АГРС stations to Novopavlovka and Zhympity) with 'начальными объемами 120 миллионов кубических метров в год и окончательными объемами до 500 миллионов кубических метров в год' (initial volumes 120 million m3/y, final/ultimate design volumes up to 500 million m3/y = 0.5 bcm/y) -- i.e. 0.5 bcm/y is Segment I's ULTIMATE DESIGN capacity from a 2007 construction resolution, not Segment II's capacity. Segment II is a structurally different, later, separate project: per Government Resolution P2500000463 item 24 and epsd.kz (both cited on the Operator fill above), it is explicitly a 'лупинг' (looping line) built specifically 'для транспортировки газа с планируемого ГПЗ на месторождении Карачаганак' (to transport gas from the PLANNED gas-processing plant at Karachaganak) -- a new demand driver, not a restatement of Segment I's original design target. I searched specifically for a diameter or capacity figure attributable to Segment II alone (epsd.kz's own capacity/diameter form fields are present but empty in the visible feasibility-study record; searched Russian-language press for '508 мм' + 'лупинг'/'вторая линия' Karachaganak-Uralsk with no hits beyond the Segment-I-era 2007 resolution and a TMK pipe-supply press release that gives diameters -- 273mm, 219mm, 1016mm seamless/welded pipe -- for the ORIGINAL pipeline's construction, none matching 508mm and none attributable to Segment II). Recommend: state this scope distinction in ResearcherNotes rather than filling either field, consistent with the country-wide finding that Kazakhstan gas rows should not inherit a sibling segment's spec without their own source.
